tasks.label: build cainiao
args: if (!(Test-Path build)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory build | Out-Null }; if (Get-Command cl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { cl /nologo /utf-8 /W4 /std:c11 main.c /Fe:build\CainiaoStation.exe } elseif (Get-Command gcc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -O2 main.c -o build\CainiaoStation.exe } else { Write-Error 'No C compiler found'; exit 1 }
